sentences: Boolean formula satisfiability asks whether some assignment makes a formula true.
With n variables, exhaustive search checks all \(2^{n}\) assignments, paying an additional cost to evaluate the formula.
The selected research direction seeks an algorithm that improves this worst-case search bound for general formulas.
Restrictions on clause width, depth, or size can change which techniques apply, so gains for specialized families do not automatically answer it.
A successful approach would identify exploitable structure in arbitrary formulas even when polynomial-time solvability remains out of reach.
